items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Peiju was, uh, he taught you how to master your cards.

ctx.x: I was wondering some more about your lessons with Papa Teo. What did he teach you? Anything special that you can remember?

Well, Papa Teo was very good. He taught, he taught you all kinds of, uh, Peiju was, uh, he taught you how to master your cards. He taught you, you, different keys that you could pick up, a number so easy. You'd pick up a number so easy. He'd teach you the cards that you could pick up easily. You wouldn't have any trouble and difficulty picking up a number. And, uh, he always would, uh, be very careful in what you were playing. He could sit down there or sit down in the kitchen in the front room and let you be…
Is it quite, very strict? Oh, yeah. Hold on. Wouldn't take your money.
